confirmed_mismatches.official_rule: NI is allowed only when retransmitting a case first received in E2B(R2) whose equivalent C.1.7 value was absent; otherwise only false or true may be used.
confirmed_mismatches.repository_state: Registry, generated contracts, frontend map, and DB allow NI structurally. MFDS validation only forces true for CT/CU and does not establish the R2-retransmission precondition for postmarket MFDS reports.

confirmed_mismatches.official_rule: NullFlavor is forbidden for both MFDS-approved clinical-trial SUSAR and compassionate-use approval SUSAR reports.
confirmed_mismatches.repository_state: Validator forbids NullFlavor only when clinical is true; compassionate-use reports are omitted from the prohibition.

confirmed_mismatches.official_rule: For domestic CT/CU reporting, the protocol/study title is mandatory but NullFlavor is explicitly allowed.

confirmed_mismatches.repository_state: Registry, contract, frontend and DB correctly retain ASKU/NASK, but MFDS receiver validation rejects any study_name NullFlavor and requires a concrete value.

confirmed_mismatches.official_rule: The WHO-UMC result field is available for postmarket domestic reports when G.k.9.i.2.r.2.KR.1 is WHO-UMC; the value is 1-6 or NullFlavor NA.
confirmed_mismatches.repository_state: Exact value and NA sets are correct in registry, contracts, frontend and DB. The validator's required context is has_source && WHO-UMC and is not gated by receiver_is_kr, so the Korean field can be required outside postmarket domestic reporting.

repository_source_quality_findings.finding: The unverified MFDS workbook says UNK, while registry/dictionary/rules/mfds.json says MSK. The current frontend map says UNK. This cannot be resolved from the MFDS public guide because the guide does not enumerate F.r.1; use the official ICH core table as authority.
The workbook contains the invalid token NSK. The generated MFDS rules normalize these to MSK. This is a workbook typo correction, not evidence of an MFDS regional override.

limitations: The public MFDS guide explicitly says its validation uses the current MFDS portal rule version, but that complete live rule table is not attached to the public guide. Therefore the exact allowed sets for rows marked match_with_ich_dependency must be proven by the official ICH source audit, not by the local MFDS workbook.

No official nedrug.mfds.go.kr download corresponding exactly to registry/sources/mfds-safety-r3-business-rules.xlsx could be located. Its 62-row NullFlavor sheet is useful as repository provenance but is not accepted here as an authoritative public source.
